title.purpose: Section headings painted on the board.

pocket-label.purpose: Tool names inside the silhouette, fixed 2rem strip.

location-code.purpose: A1, A2... on the pocket floor, revealed on lift.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: A plate hanging flush on its hook. Foam: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A plate lifted off its hook. Foam: black at 0.7 / 0.3.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Label tape stuck to the board.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Hover/focus on a hung plate (hover-capable pointers only). Swing roughly ±0.7° to ±1.6°, alternating across neighbours.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: from translateY(-16px) rotate(var(--swing)); 0.75s ease-out; delay calc(var(--i) * 80ms + 150ms)
motion.purpose: Plates drop into their outlines once on load.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Replaces lift and settle under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: tape-hover
motion.purpose: Action tape text turns live red.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Board collapses to one 46rem column; pocket-pad 20px.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: One tool per row; card steps stack; pocket-pad 16px; body 1rem.

focus.purpose: Every link; the ring follows the pocket curve.

components.css: :host{--board:#F2C230;--pocket:#1C1C1A;--on-pocket:#F2C230;--laminate:#FBFAF6;--paint:#1C1C1A;--live:#C8372D;--live-ink:#FFFFFF;--rest:0 1px 2px rgb(28 28 26 / 0.3);--lift:0 12px 16px -12px rgb(28 28 26 / 0.45), 0 2px 4px rgb(28 28 26 / 0.18);--font-paint:'Big Shoulders Stencil','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-print:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);--pocket-pad:24px}.ds-pocket{display:block;background:var(--pocket);border-radius:16px;padding:var(--pocket-pad) var(--pocket-pad) 12px}.ds-slot{position:relative;display:block}.ds-slot::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:3px 3px 9px;border:2px solid var(--on-pocket);border-radius:5px}.ds-code{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2px;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:0 6px;background:var(--pocket);color:var(--on-pocket);font:800 1rem/1 var(--font-paint);letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-hook{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(7px - var(--pocket-pad));width:10px;height:calc(var(--pocket-pad) - 7px);transform:translateX(-50%)}.ds-hook::before,.ds-hook::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--on-pocket)}.ds-hook::before{top:0;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}.ds-hook::after{top:6px;bottom:0;width:3px}.ds-label{display:block;height:2rem;padding:.7rem 0 0;color:var(--on-pocket);font:800 1.3rem/1 var(--font-paint);letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-plate{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;background:var(--laminate);border-radius:5px;padding:6px;box-shadow:var(--rest);transform-origin:50% 0;transition:transform .5s var(--ease-out),box-shadow .5s var(--ease-out)}.ds-tool:hover .ds-plate,.ds-tool:focus-visible .ds-plate{transform:translateY(-24px) rotate(-1.4deg);box-shadow:var(--lift)}.ds-tool{display:inline-block;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-tool:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--live);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:16px}

narrative.overview:
The page is a lean-manufacturing 5S shadow board: a drenched safety-yellow painted board where every object hangs from its own peg inside a paint-black silhouette cut a hand's width larger than the object. Nothing floats in space; everything has a painted home, and the home is visible the moment the object leaves it. The board says "this person keeps a tidy shop and makes real tools" without a single adjective.

Two material registers divide every surface. Anything **painted on the board** (the name, section headings, pocket labels, location codes, step numerals) is stencil lettering. Anything **printed and mounted** (headline, bio, label-maker tape, laminated plates, cards) is Archivo. In the dark scheme the board becomes two-layer tool foam: a black top layer with yellow showing through every cut pocket, so the same silhouettes read as cut-outs instead of paint.

Motion obeys gravity only. Objects settle onto their hooks once on load, lift off with a small swing when hovered or focused, and fall back. Nothing slides, fades, or scrolls into view. The board rejects gradients, glass, icon tiles, and the centered avatar-bio-button-card stack.
keyCharacteristics: One flat, saturated field color with no gradient or texture.
Paint-black silhouettes with generous 16px corners hold every object.
Two type registers: stencil for paint, Archivo for print, never mixed within one object.
White laminate and label tape are the only light surfaces on the board.
One red, reserved for the live element and live states.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks the live element and live states only: the primary exit, hover on an action, focus. Never decoration, never a second accent, never a heading.

rules.name: The Paint-Through Rule
rules.body: Lettering inside a silhouette is always the board color showing through (`--on-pocket`), never white or grey. In the foam scheme the roles swap together: yellow pockets, black lettering.

rules.name: The Laminate Never Inverts Rule
rules.body: Printed objects (plates, tape, cards) keep white stock and black ink in both schemes. Only the board and its paint change.

rules.name: The Paint or Print Rule
rules.body: Ask of every piece of text: is it painted on the board or printed and mounted? Painted is Big Shoulders Stencil 800, uppercase. Printed is Archivo. There is no third face and no stencil body copy.

rules.name: The Squeeze, Don't Swap Rule
rules.body: Condensed Archivo comes from `font-stretch` (75% for tape and plates, 87.5% for the headline), not from a separate condensed family.

rules.name: The Hand's Width Rule
rules.body: Every silhouette is the object plus a fixed painted margin (`pocket-pad`: 24px, 20px at ≤68rem, 16px at ≤40rem) on top and sides, with the label strip below. The margin also sizes the hook, which spans exactly from the pocket's top edge to the plate.

rules.name: The Gravity Rule
rules.body: Shadows answer to gravity: they appear only under a hung or stuck object and lengthen only when that object is lifted. No ambient glows, no floating cards at rest, no hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Soft Cut, Hard Object Rule
rules.body: The cut or painted home is round; the object in it is almost square. Never round a plate to match its pocket.

dos: **Do** give every new object its own pocket, slot, hook, and location code, continuing the sequence (A4, A5…).
**Do** decide paint or print before setting any text: Big Shoulders Stencil 800 uppercase if painted on the board, Archivo if printed.
**Do** keep red to the one live plate, hover on actions, and the 3px focus ring (6px offset).
**Do** keep laminated plates and tape white with black ink in both schemes.
**Do** keep all motion as gravity: settle, lift (-24px with swing), fall back; swap it for a red pocket under reduced motion.
**Do** recompute the rack column split whenever a screenshot's aspect ratio changes, so paired plates share one height.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glass, or textures on the board, or add any accent beyond the yellow and the one red.
**Don't** put icons in tiles or badges. The only icon is a small inline outbound arrow on tape and the live plate.
**Don't** float cards or add shadows to silhouettes, text, or the board. Only hung plates and stuck tape cast shadows.
**Don't** slide, fade, or scroll-animate anything in.
**Don't** set body copy, descriptions, or buttons in the stencil face, or set painted names and headings in Archivo.
**Don't** fall back to the centered avatar, bio, button, and project-card stack.
